info.title: SchoolDigger API
info.description: K-12 school and district data for 120,000+ U.S. schools

get.description: Search the SchoolDigger database for districts. You may use any combination of criteria as query parameters. New in v2.4: location searches (nearLatitude/nearLongitude, boundaryAddress, or box coordinates) no longer require 'st' and may return districts from more than one state.

parameters.name: st
parameters.description: Two character state (e.g. 'CA') - optional if you supply a location search (nearLatitude/nearLongitude, boundaryAddress, or box coordinates); required otherwise. Location searches without 'st' may return districts from multiple states.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term - note: will match district name or city (optional)

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Search for districts in this city (optional)

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Search for districts in this 5-digit zip code (optional)

parameters.name: nearLatitude
parameters.description: Search for districts within (distanceMiles) of (nearLatitude)/(nearLongitude) (e.g. 44.982560) (optional) (Pro, Enterprise API levels only. Enterprise API level will flag districts that include lat/long in its attendance boundary.)

parameters.name: nearLongitude
parameters.description: Search for districts within (distanceMiles) of (nearLatitude)/(nearLongitude) (e.g. -124.289185) (optional) (Pro, Enterprise API levels only. Enterprise API level will flag districts that include lat/long in its attendance boundary.)

parameters.name: boundaryAddress
parameters.description: Full U.S. address: flag returned districts that include this address in its attendance boundary. Example: '123 Main St. AnyTown CA 90001' (optional) (Enterprise API level only)

parameters.name: distanceMiles
parameters.description: Search for districts within (distanceMiles) of (nearLatitude)/(nearLongitude) (Default 50 miles) (optional) (Pro, Enterprise API levels only)

parameters.name: isInBoundaryOnly
parameters.description: Return only the districts that include given location (nearLatitude/nearLongitude) or (boundaryAddress) in its attendance boundary (Enterprise API level only)

parameters.name: boxLatitudeNW
parameters.description: Search for districts within a 'box' defined by (BoxLatitudeNW/BoxLongitudeNW) to (BoxLongitudeSE/BoxLatitudeSE) (optional)

parameters.name: boxLongitudeNW
parameters.description: Search for districts within a 'box' defined by (BoxLatitudeNW/BoxLongitudeNW) to (BoxLongitudeSE/BoxLatitudeSE) (optional)

parameters.name: boxLatitudeSE
parameters.description: Search for districts within a 'box' defined by (BoxLatitudeNW/BoxLongitudeNW) to (BoxLongitudeSE/BoxLatitudeSE) (optional)

parameters.name: boxLongitudeSE
parameters.description: Search for districts within a 'box' defined by (BoxLatitudeNW/BoxLongitudeNW) to (BoxLongitudeSE/BoxLatitudeSE) (optional)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve (optional, default: 1)

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of districts to retrieve on a page (50 max) (optional, default: 10)

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort list. Values are: districtname, distance, rank. For descending order, precede with '-' i.e. -districtname (optional, default: districtname)

parameters.name: includeUnrankedDistrictsInRankSort
parameters.description: If sortBy is 'rank', this boolean determines if districts with no rank are included in the result (optional, default: false)

get.summary: Returns a detailed record for one district
get.description: Retrieve a single district record from the SchoolDigger database. Version 3.0 adds includeRanges: with it, test-score percent metrics are a number when the state reported an exact value, otherwise an object describing a range, a suppressed value, a legacy stand-in or a derived value (see APIReportedPercent); without it the record is identical to v2.4.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 7 digit District ID (e.g. 0642150)

parameters.name: includeRanges
parameters.description: true = return test-score percent metrics as the state reported them: a number when exact, otherwise an object with a status ('range', 'suppressed', 'legacyImputed' or 'derived') and, when available, value / low / high; rows the state reported only as ranges or suppressed values are included. false (default) = the record is identical to v2.4 (exact values only). See https://developer.schooldigger.com/data-quality (optional)

get.summary: Returns a detailed record for one school
get.description: Retrieve a school record from the SchoolDigger database. Version 3.1 adds lowIncome (the school's low-income measure: free/reduced-price lunch eligibility, else direct certification, else Community Eligibility) and, for each year in schoolYearlyDetails, freeReducedLunch and directCertification. It also adds vaccination: the state's published vaccination rates for the school (source, headline and every figure by year, grade, vaccine and status, with the state's own district, county and state figures for the same measures; by default the headline grade for its most recent year; includeVaccinationDetail=true for every grade and year). includeRanges works as in 3.0 and only changes test scores.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 12 digit School ID (e.g. 064215006903)

parameters.name: includeRanges
parameters.description: true = return test-score percent metrics as the state reported them: a number when exact, otherwise an object with a status ('range', 'suppressed', 'legacyImputed' or 'derived') and, when available, value / low / high; rows the state reported only as ranges or suppressed values are included. false (default) = test scores as in v2.4 (exact values only). See https://developer.schooldigger.com/data-quality (optional)

parameters.name: includeVaccinationDetail
parameters.description: true = vaccination.figures holds every grade and every school year with published vaccination figures (years within your plan's yearly history window, as schoolYearlyDetails); false (default) = one grade (the headline grade, else the first grade published for the school) for its most recent year. vaccination.gradesAvailable and vaccination.yearsAvailable list what exists either way. (optional)

get.description: Search the SchoolDigger database for schools. You may use any combination of criteria as query parameters. APIDistrictFull30.description:
District detail record for API 3.0. Identical to 2.4 (APIDistrictFull21) except testScores, whose percent metrics
are a number or an APIReportedPercent object and whose rows are no longer limited to what the pre-2026 importers
produced (docs/suppressed-test-values-spec.md R6).

testScores.description: Standardized test score results with district and state comparisons. Each entry represents one test/subject/grade/year combination. District-level records do not include schoolTestScore. Percent metrics are a number when the state reported an exact value, otherwise an object describing a range, a suppressed value, a legacy stand-in or a derived value (see APIReportedPercent). Requires Pro or Enterprise API subscription.

lowGrade.description: The low grade served by this district (PK = Prekindergarten, K = Kindergarten)

highGrade.description: The high grade served by this district

finance.description: Yearly per-student spending data. Array is sorted most recent year first. spendingPerStudent is available at Pro level; detailed federal/state/local and personnel/non-personnel breakdowns require Enterprise level.

graduationRates.description: 4-year adjusted cohort graduation rates at district and state levels (Pro and Enterprise API level only). Array is sorted most recent year first.

dropoutRates.description: Annual dropout rates at district and state levels (Pro and Enterprise API level only). Array is sorted most recent year first.

chronicAbsenteeismRates.description: Chronic absenteeism rates (students missing 15+ days) at district and state levels (Pro and Enterprise API level only). Array is sorted most recent year first. Data availability varies by state.

isWithinBoundary.description: Indicates whether this district's boundary includes the specified location from nearLatitude/nearLongitude

rankHistory.description: SchoolDigger yearly rank history for this district, sorted most recent year first. Districts are ranked statewide regardless of level.

districtYearlyDetails.description: Yearly enrollment and staffing details for this district. Array is sorted most recent year first. Includes detailed FTE staffing breakdowns by role (teachers by level, administrators, counselors, librarians, support staff).

APITestScoreWrapper30.description:
One test / subject / grade / year entry as returned by API 3.0, with school, district and state APITestScore30
objects. Unlike API 2.4 (APITestScoreWrapper) it does not hide rows the pre-2026 importer would not have
produced (spec R0 Invariant 2): a score object is present whenever the state reported anything for that level,
and the entry is present whenever at least one score object is.

test.description: The name of the state-administered test

grade.description: Grade level for which this test score applies (e.g. '3', '5', '8', '10', 'HS')

tier1.description: Label for the lowest performance tier on this test (e.g. 'Below Basic', 'Level 1'). Tier labels are state-specific. Enterprise API level only.

tier2.description: Label for the second performance tier (e.g. 'Basic', 'Level 2'). Enterprise API level only.

tier3.description: Label for the third performance tier (e.g. 'Proficient', 'Level 3'). Enterprise API level only.

tier4.description: Label for the fourth performance tier (e.g. 'Advanced', 'Level 4'). Enterprise API level only.

tier5.description: Label for the fifth performance tier, if applicable (e.g. 'No Score'). Not all states use 5 tiers. Enterprise API level only.

polylineCollection.description: Collection of one or more Google Maps encoded polylines representing the attendance boundary. IMPORTANT: Polyline strings are JSON-encoded with escaped backslashes (double backslashes). You must unescape before passing to Google Maps decoding functions. Multiple polylines represent districts/schools with non-contiguous boundary areas.

APIReportedPercent.description:
A percent metric (percentMetStandard, percentTier1..5) that the state did not publish as a single exact number.
In API 3.0 a percent metric is EITHER a plain number (the state reported an exact value) OR this object, and is
absent when nothing was reported. status is one of: 'range' (the state published only a range: low / high are
the state's bounds), 'suppressed' (withheld by the state to protect student privacy; no value), 'legacyImputed'
(a pre-2018 SchoolDigger stand-in: value is the 4 / 96 number older API versions return, low / high are the
state's bounds), 'derived' (computed by SchoolDigger from the other reported levels: value when exact, otherwise
low / high). Rendering rule: exact 82.3 -> '82.3%'; low 0 -> '< 10%'; high 100 -> '>= 95%'; otherwise
'10-15%'; suppressed -> a dash. See https://developer.schooldigger.com/data-quality

status.description: Why there is no exact number: 'range', 'suppressed', 'legacyImputed' or 'derived'

value.description: The percent value, when one exists (status 'derived' with an exact result, or the 'legacyImputed' stand-in). Absent otherwise.

low.description: Lower bound of the range in percent (0 means 'less than high'). Absent for 'suppressed'.

high.description: Upper bound of the range in percent (100 means 'at least low'). Absent for 'suppressed'.

APITestScore30.description:
One test result (school, district or state level) as returned by API 3.0. Same members as the 2.4 object except
that the six percent metrics are either a plain number or an APIReportedPercent object (see that class), and a
score object is returned whenever the state reported anything - including a result that consists only of
suppressed or ranged values. Hand-written (not inherited from clsSD2testScore) because the number-or-object
union cannot come from the reflection copy the 2.4 models use.

studentsEligible.description: Count of students eligible to take test

percentMetStandard.description: Percent of students meeting state standard: a number when the state reported an exact value, otherwise an APIReportedPercent object (range, suppressed, legacyImputed or derived). Absent when not reported.

numberMetStandard.description: Count of students meeting state standard

numTier1.description: Count of students performing at tier 1 (Enterprise API level only)

numTier2.description: Count of students performing at tier 2 (Enterprise API level only)

numTier3.description: Count of students performing at tier 3 (Enterprise API level only)

numTier4.description: Count of students performing at tier 4 (Enterprise API level only)

numTier5.description: Count of students performing at tier 5 (Enterprise API level only)

percentTier1.description: Percent of students performing at tier 1 (Enterprise API level only): a number when exact, otherwise an APIReportedPercent object. Absent when not reported.

percentTier2.description: Percent of students performing at tier 2 (Enterprise API level only): a number when exact, otherwise an APIReportedPercent object. Absent when not reported.

percentTier3.description: Percent of students performing at tier 3 (Enterprise API level only): a number when exact, otherwise an APIReportedPercent object. Absent when not reported.

percentTier4.description: Percent of students performing at tier 4 (Enterprise API level only): a number when exact, otherwise an APIReportedPercent object. Absent when not reported.

percentTier5.description: Percent of students performing at tier 5 (Enterprise API level only): a number when exact, otherwise an APIReportedPercent object. Absent when not reported.

APIVaxSource.description: The state agency and publication the vaccination figures come from (API 3.1).

id.description: SchoolDigger source id; figures from another source carry it as sourceId

agency.description: Publishing agency, e.g. "Washington State Department of Health"

url.description: The agency's page for the data

headlineLabel.description: What the state's headline figure measures, e.g. "Kindergartners complete for all required immunizations". Absent when the state publishes no headline (e.g. HI: exemptions only)

suppressionNote.description: How the state suppresses small groups, when it says so

suppressedCountText.description: The meaning of a redacted count, e.g. "fewer than 10" (figures with value.status "redactedCount")

districtScope.description: What the state's district figures cover: "public" (public schools only) or "publicAndPrivate" (public and private schools in the district's area); absent when the state does not say or publishes no district figures

stateFigureLabel.description: What the state figure covers when it is not statewide, e.g. "reporting schools" (NC); absent = statewide

isLegacy.description: True for figures migrated from an older SchoolDigger source the state no longer publishes in that form

APIVaxHeadline.description: The headline vaccination figure (API 3.1): one grade, vaccine and status per state, as the state leads with it (e.g. kindergartners with all required vaccines, or with MMR where the state publishes no all-vaccine figure).

grade.description: Grade code: "PK", "KG", "01"-"12", or "14" = all grades in the school

label.description: The state's label for the headline, e.g. "Kindergartners complete for all required immunizations"

level.description: "school"; "district" when the state publishes the figure for the school's district only (see isDistrictFigure); "county" when the state publishes neither (e.g. NYC public schools: the borough figure); "district" on district records

isDistrictFigure.description: True when the value is the district's published figure, not the school's (the state reports public schools as districts, e.g. TX). Absent otherwise

sector.description: "public" or "private" when the value is a county figure the state published for one sector only (e.g. NYC public schools: the borough's public-school figure); absent otherwise

students.description: Students with this status, when published

studentsTotal.description: Students the state counted (enrolled, or with a record on file, as the state defines it), when published

exemptionRate.description: Exemption rate (0-100) at the headline grade and year, as published: any exemption, else medical + non-medical, else medical where the state allows only medical exemptions. Absent when not published

notes.description: Ids of the notes (vaccination.notes) that apply to the value

APIVaxGrade.description: A grade code and its name (API 3.1 vaccination lookups).

code.description: Grade code: "PK", "KG", "01"-"12", or "14" = all grades in the school

APIVaxFigure.description: One published vaccination measure (API 3.1): a school year, grade, vaccine and status, with the value at each level the state publishes it for. A level is absent when the state published nothing for it.

grade.description: Grade code: "PK", "KG", "01"-"12", or "14" = all grades in the school (names in vaccination.grades)

antigen.description: Vaccine code (names in vaccination.antigens); ALL = all required vaccines

status.description: Status code (names and groups in vaccination.statuses)

APIVaxCode.description: A vaccine (antigen) or a vaccination status: a stable code and its display name (API 3.1). Antigen codes include ALL (all required vaccines), MMR, MEASLES, DTP_TD, TDAP, POLIO, HEPB, VARICELLA, MENACWY; status codes include IMMUNIZED, COMPLIANT, CONDITIONAL, NOT_UP_TO_DATE, EXEMPT_ANY, EXEMPT_MEDICAL, EXEMPT_NONMEDICAL, EXEMPT_RELIGIOUS, EXEMPT_PERSONAL. New codes can be added when a state publishes a new measure.

group.description: Statuses only: "coverage" (students who have the vaccines), "exemption" (students exempt) or "other" (conditional, not up to date, no record and similar)

APIVaxNote.description: A footnote the state's data carries (API 3.1), e.g. a change of definition between years. Figures list the ids of the notes that apply to them.

id.description: Note id, as listed in a figure's notes

APIFreeReducedLunch.description: Students eligible for free or reduced-price school meals in one school year (API 3.1). Either count and percent, or a status when the reported count is not usable as a percent: "communityEligibility" (count is 98% or more of enrollment; the school likely serves free meals to all students), "repeated" (the state repeated the prior year's counts for most schools; not shown), "aboveEnrollment" (count exceeds enrollment; not shown).

status.description: Absent when count and percent are usable; otherwise "communityEligibility", "repeated" or "aboveEnrollment"

count.description: Number of students eligible for free or reduced-price meals (absent for "repeated" and "aboveEnrollment")

percent.description: Percent of enrolled students excluding pre-kindergarten (0-100, two decimals); absent when status is present

APIDirectCertification.description: Students directly certified for free meals in one school year (API 3.1): approved automatically, without a meal application, through SNAP, TANF, FDPIR or Medicaid (most states), or because they are homeless, migrant, runaway, in foster care or in Head Start. Usually lower than free/reduced lunch eligibility and not comparable to it. Collected from 2016-17.

count.description: Number of students directly certified for free meals

percent.description: Percent of enrolled students excluding pre-kindergarten (0-100, two decimals)

APIVaxValue.description: A vaccination value as the state published it (API 3.1). status: "exact" (pct), "range" (rangeLow / rangeHigh; e.g. 95-100 for a published "95% or more"), "suppressed" (the state withheld the percent, usually for small groups; see source.suppressionNote), "redactedCount" (the state withheld a student count, e.g. "fewer than 10": see source.suppressedCountText), "countOnly" (the state published a count of students, not a percent: see students / studentsTotal) or "invalid" (not given: the published value is outside 0-100, qualityFlag 1, or the state's own figures contradict it, e.g. a non-report printed as zeros, qualityFlag 2).

pct.description: Percent of students (0-100), as published; status "exact" only

rangeLow.description: Lower bound of a published range (0-100); status "range" only

rangeHigh.description: Upper bound of a published range (0-100); status "range" only

APIVaxLevelValue.description: One level's published value for a measure (API 3.1): the school's own figure, or the state's own published district, county or state figure for the same year, grade, vaccine and status. SchoolDigger never calculates district, county or state figures; they appear only where the state publishes them.

status.description: "exact" (pct), "range" (rangeLow / rangeHigh; e.g. 95-100 for a published "95% or more"), "suppressed" (percent withheld by the state, usually for small groups; see source.suppressionNote), "redactedCount" (a student count withheld by the state, e.g. "fewer than 10": see source.suppressedCountText), "countOnly" (a count of students, no percent: see students / studentsTotal) or "invalid" (not given: the published value is outside 0-100, qualityFlag 1, or the state's own figures contradict it, e.g. a non-report printed as zeros, qualityFlag 2)

pct.description: Percent of students (0-100), as published; status "exact" only

rangeLow.description: Lower bound of a published range (0-100); status "range" only

rangeHigh.description: Upper bound of a published range (0-100); status "range" only

students.description: Students with this status, when published

studentsTotal.description: Students the state counted for this figure (enrolled, or with a record on file, or required to have this vaccine, as the state defines it), when published

sector.description: County and state figures: "public" or "private" when the state published the figure for one sector only (the school's own); absent = all schools

qualityFlag.description: 1 = the published value is outside 0-100; 2 = the state's own figures contradict it, e.g. a non-report printed as zeros (status "invalid" either way)

notes.description: Ids of the notes (vaccination.notes) that apply to this figure

sourceId.description: Source id when the figure comes from one of vaccination.otherSources; absent = vaccination.source
